name: Carbromal
summary: Carbromal is a hypnotic and sedative originally synthesized by Bayer in 1909 and later marketed as Adalin. Parke-Davis later marketed the drug in combination with pentobarbital as Carbrital. As of 2015, it was still used in Hungary in combination with aminophenazone under the name Demalgon.
